prerequisites: Knowledge of mathematical analysis, matrix algebra
Knowledge of fundamental laws in statics, kinematics and dynamics
Skill in fuction analysis, derivatives, basic matrix and vector operations

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge in topology, kinematics and dynamics of mechanisms and manipulators
Acquire and understanding of basic mechanisms and manipulators
Getting skills in determining kinematic and dynamic parameters
Understands theoretical fundamentals of mechanism and robot topology
Has the knowledge of kinematic and dynamic analysis methods
Is able to commentate results of analysis, evaluate their correctness
Is able to evaluate topological carrectness of kinematic systems
Is able to determine kinematic and dynamic properties
Is able to create models of simple planar mechanisms and manipulators
Has a conviction of responsibility for the work done

syllabus_topics: Topology of mechanisms, movable properties, redundant constraints
Kinematics of mechanisms - graphic-analytical methods
Analytical methods in kinematics (vectors, projections, time derivatives)
Planetary gear trains
Manipulators' properties. Planar serial and parallel systems
Kinematics of planar manipulators, jacobian
Matrix description of spatial systems
Denavit-Hartenberg notation
Introduction to mechanisms' dynamics
Kinetostatic analysis
Friction in joints, efficiency
Dynamic motion analysis
Fluctuation o machine motion, flyweels

Introduction to modelling mechanisms in SAM (Simulation and Analysis of Mechanisms) 
– presentation of examplesi
Mechanisms' topology: rules of drawing digrams, topology analysis - joint classification, mobility (test, project)
Rules of creating models in SAM system, creating simple models, model motion simulation, presentation of analysis results
Dimensional modelling of mechanisms, drivers' definition, massis, external loads
Kinematic analysis - position analysis (project)
Kinematic analysis - velocity and acceleration determination - vector methods (test, project)
Kinematic analysis - velocity and acceleration determination using SAM (project)
Kinematic analysis using analytical methods: loop equation, vectors, projections, time derivatives (project)
Planar manipulators - kinematic analysis using matrix notation
Modelling manipulators in SAM: forward and inverse tasks (project)
Anaysis of planetary transmissions, angular velocity ratio determination (test, project)
Modelling of planetary transmissions and gear linkage mechanisms using SAM (project)
Joint force and external equilibrium determination (test, project)
Determination of joint forces including friction (test, project)
Dynamic force analysis using SAM
teaching_methods: self study - preparation for project class
assessment_rules: For the lecture, the concluding grade is based on the examination result. For the project, the concluding grade is the average of all grades.
